2464.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $n!

2527.text: Greetings.  I'm an undead mage trainer, and you're a mage.
2527.text1: Greetings.  I'm an undead mage trainer, and you're a mage.

2529.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?
2529.text1: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

2821.text1: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

2825.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.
2825.text1: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

2828.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

3356.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

4350.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

5942.text: I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.$B$BHe claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

5943.text: I thank you, $n. Your dedication to my plea gives rest to my lost wife's spirit, and for that I could never repay you enough.$B$BI cannot say that my hatred will ever cease for the quilboar, but it is satiated for now.$B$BNow I must begin to rebuild my life.

5963.text1: The body is that of a female orc warrior.$B$BIt is clear that she died in battle, probably against the quilboar in the area.

5965.text1: You turn the body over and see the marks from blades and spells upon the deceased orc--her armor all but destroyed, her hair matted to her face.$B$BBased on Mankrik's description of her, there is no doubt in your mind that this was his wife.$B$BHe will be upset by the news, but you are sure he should know the truth.

5969.text: Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.$B$BPlease, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.$B$BThere are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

6075.text: You! $R! Come here. <snort>$B$BTime is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>$B$BMy capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!$B$BThe Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

6077.text: My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.$B$BLong ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>$B$BGreat thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

7214.text: Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.$B$BI deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

7217.text: Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.$B$BIf you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.$B$BBut there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

7218.text: All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $n. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.$B$BIt is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.$B$BUnderstand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

7228.text: Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.$B$BOur great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

7260.text: It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.$B$BKnow this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.$B$BMany cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.$B$BGroups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

7262.text: Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.$B$BThat fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.

7263.text: Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!$B$BLook at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

7264.text: Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.

7265.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

7584.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

7586.text: No other race on Azeroth has suffered as much as our people, $c. To laugh in the face of death has become second nature for all of us.

7868.text1: Hail, traveler! What brings you to my doorstep?

7894.text: If you have what it takes, I will be happy to show you the way.

8089.text: I am afraid that I am no longer gentle or humble. Age and countless battles have hardened my skin and soul. Perhaps that is why Cairne assigned me to Sun Rock Retreat... the gentle winds and warm sun does ease the pain.

8095.text: How may I be of service?

8111.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

8116.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

8122.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

8163.text1: Your knowledge is great, traveler. You must learn from one who is wiser than I. Many tales have been told of the wisdom of Josef Gregorian. You may find him in Undercity.

8263.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.
8263.text1: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

8289.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $n.
8289.text1: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $n.

8300.text: The darkness does not embrace you, $c.  Cease your prattle and remove yourself from my sight!  Be gone!
8300.text1: The darkness does not embrace you, $c.  Cease your prattle and remove yourself from my sight!  Be gone!

8330.text: Stonetalon Mountain has many perilous caves through out this region.  Exploring these caves can hold many adventures for those willing to risk life for glory.$B$B$C, perhaps you seek riches that only following your heart and soul can garnish.

8402.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.
8402.text1: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

8403.text: You're no warlock and I've no time for you.  Begone!
8403.text1: You're no warlock and I've no time for you.  Begone!

8406.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?
8406.text1: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

8474.text1: Between the light and the dark, there is shadow... and those shadows have powers you have yet to see.

8877.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

9877.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?
9877.text1: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

10029.text: Where can I send you today $c?

10030.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

10031.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.

10753.text: Where would you like to fly to?
10753.text1: Where would you like to fly to?

11729.text: Hey, $gmister:miss;.  You look like a $C with discerning tastes in wine.  I have a favor to ask, and I think I can make you an offer you can't refuse...forget about it!

290401.text: Welcome back to the light, friend. Do you require training?
290401.text1: Welcome back to the light, friend. Do you require training?

296783.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

300037.text: H-Hello. You'll have to excuse me, I'm used to your kind running from me.

300039.text:
That is... a very good question. I have a hard time remembering things, but I do remember something... "Engineer", perhaps? I think that's what, or who, I was.

Other than that, all I can seem to remember is soaring through the sky, then seeing a flash of lightning before things got very bumpy. Then... a crash.

It's been... a long time though. A very long time.

300042.text:
Oh, these things? I built them. My little friends helped me. I'm not very good at remembering things, but, um, I do know that at one point I used to build a lot of things. Big things! But then, like I said... I was here. The things I build aren't so big and impressive anymore. Still makes me h-happy, heh.

B-but... If you want, I can show you how to build things too!

300662.text: If you need training as a cook, I have a few tips and tricks I could pass on! Ho ho! Throw on an apron and let's get started!

301916.text: <This cultist is dead. Upon close inspection, you notice that he seems to be clutching something to his chest, almost as if he was protecting it.>
301916.text1: <This cultist is dead. Upon close inspection, you notice that he seems to be clutching something to his chest, almost as if he was protecting it.>

302063.text1: With the cult running roughshod over most of the island with impunity, Lorthuna undoubtedly thinks we are on the back foot. We can use that overconfidence against her.

302064.text1: I believe that with a proper distraction at the shrine, a small force of Peacekeepers, Windshapers, and High Order should be able to push up a flank and break into the inner sanctum. From there, we take out the High Priestess herself and cut the head off the snake.

302065.text1: Go and speak with the leaders of the Windshapers and the High Order, respectively. They don't get along, but I think they can recognize that the bigger threat is the Al'Aketh. Get them to agree to the plan and then return here.

302067.text1: Greetings, I am Ayessa Dawnsinger, the current Grand Skyseer of the Windshapers. What may I do for you?

302068.text1:
If the High Order gave any mind at all to actually solving the problems we face and spent less time obsessing over the old magic, we'd be in a far better position as a people. It was highborne magic that brought about the ruin of the kaldorei to begin with. Those self-absorbed fools seek to repeat those mistakes!

The fact that they attempted to make peace with the cult is bad enough, but spilling Windshaper blood is what is truly unforgivable. Were it not for the imminent threat of the cult, I'd gather up our forces and go put an end to Elaadrin and the High Order once and for all.

302072.text1: Hmm, I see. Very well then, $c. The Windshapers will provide aid. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

302089.text:
<Elaadrin eyes you with barely-contained hatred.> 

You would dare step foot into our sanctum after spilling High Order blood? You are very brave, or very stupid. The High Order does not forgive, nor do we forget.

Someday, you will pay for your crimes in blood.

302090.text:
Hmm, I see. Very well then, $c. The High Order will assist the Peacekeepers. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

<Elaadrin lowers his voice dangerously.>

Do not mistake our willing cooperation for any sort of clemency. You owe the High Order blood, and we always collect on our debts.

302093.text:
The Peacekeepers can't hope to muster the numbers needed for an outright assault on the shrine. Without the Windshapers and the High Order bolstering our numbers, we stand no chance. They both pledged their aid when we need it. Now is the time.

Unfortunately, some recent events have led to outright bloodshed between the two factions, and tensions are high.

How do you feel about a bit of diplomacy?
302093.text1:
The Peacekeepers can't hope to muster the numbers needed for an outright assault on the shrine. Without the Windshapers and the High Order bolstering our numbers, we stand no chance. They both pledged their aid when we need it. Now is the time.

Unfortunately, some recent events have led to outright bloodshed between the two factions, and tensions are high.

How do you feel about a bit of diplomacy?

302159.text1: <Valennia is severely wounded and is barely holding on to consciousness.>

302160.text1:
Most of the cultists at the Sanctum of Storms seem to have come out to respond to our attack. I never would have expected this to go so well. This was almost too easy...

I think that the Windshapers and High Order have made their push. Valennia should be with them. You should head inside and find her. We'll stay here and keep watch while Valennia and the others finish what they came here to do.

302443.text: We came as soon as we were told what was happening. The High Order is here to serve Zephras.

302444.text1: ...and the Windshapers. We are ready to support an assault on the Shrine, Valennia.

302445.text1: You have my thanks. Being truthful, however, this is going to be a dangerous gambit and we may not succeed. It's important you understand that this might be a one-way ride.

302446.text1: We understand. As it happens Elaadrin and I spoke. We made arrangements to send for... outside aid. It's unclear if they will be able to arrive in time to help, or if they will even arrive at all...

302447.text1: Outside... of Zephras? From the other provinces? We haven't had contact with the other islands for years...?

302448.text: It's... coming from a little further away than that. We'll explain on the way.

302449.text1: Very well then. Time is not with us so we should make ourselves ready. Thank you all for your aid. Zephras is in your debt.

302811.text:
The hunters and rangers of Zephras have never been more needed. The winds grow ever harsher, and the magic that sustains our island is fading. The wilds have never been more wild, and people like me are needed to keep our people safe.

If you have the proper aptitude as a hunter, I can give you the tools to survive the wilds.
302811.text1:
The hunters and rangers of Zephras have never been more needed. The winds grow ever harsher, and the magic that sustains our island is fading. The wilds have never been more wild, and people like me are needed to keep our people safe.

If you have the proper aptitude as a hunter, I can give you the tools to survive the wilds.

303612.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?
303612.text1: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

304299.text1: Lorthuna! Stop this madness. You don't know what bringing down the wards protecting Zephras will do. You could doom us all!

304303.text1: Ayessa... my former sister. How far you've fallen, keeping company with this High Order filth.

304304.text: I'll make this easy for you, witch. Stop what you are doing now and I will make your death swift. This is the last and best offer you will get from the High Order.

304307.text1: Bring the wards down? The wards have been down for days, fools. No, I am merely lighting a beacon... for the true servants of Al'Akir to follow.

304433.text1: Ahh... yes! The call has been answered. Meet your end with joy!

304441.text: Who dares call the Lord of the East Wind?

304443.text: So the rumors were true. My wayward brothers did well to conceal this place from the gaze of Al'Akir.

304445.text1: Yes! Yes! It is by my will that the way to Zephras is open to you! Bring me before your Windlord so that he may know who was the herald of his glory!

304447.text: You dare to command me, mortal? No, I think not. Begone, insignificant elf!

304448.text1: No! Never, I would never dare!

304449.text: Well, you certainly never will again, insect. Hah!

304452.text: Enjoy your remaining time as "guests" in my lord's realm until his judgement inevitably arrives. You'll know not when, but it is coming.

304454.text: Now that this wondrous realm is no longer hidden from us, you are going to enjoy getting to know the TRUE children of Skywall...

304785.text: POWER RESTORED. READY TO RESUME FUNCTION.

304786.text: ONE MOMENT PLEASE. RECOGNITION. SHEN'DOREI. HIGH ORDER MAGISTER.

304788.text: Now we're getting somewhere. Construct, can you tell me who removed your components?

304790.text: What are you doing here? Quickly, leave this place now. You are going to ruin everything!

304792.text: Construct Parts?! Are you serious? Do you know what the Al'Aketh will do if they find us both here together? Begone with you, now. I will submit myself to your judgement later. It is not safe...

304793.text1: Belathaan... I thought we agreed to meet alone? I'd hate to think you intended to ambush me here, in the shadow of my shrine.

304794.text: No, no! Lorthuna, you do not understand. This windshaper is merely passing by. They did not come here with me!

304795.text1: It matters not. I think that I'll just have my pets kill the both of you and send your tongue back to Elaadrin as a warning to keep his little mages in Valanaar, where they belong.

304796.text: Lorthuna, be reasonable. Elaadrin sent me to discuss a path to peace and...

304797.text1: Enough. Goodbye, Belathaan and... whomever you are.

304798.text: I appreciate you bringing me Ayessa's assurances. With both the High Order and the Windshapers working with us against the greater threat, we stand a much better chance to thwart the Al'Aketh and whatever they have planned for Zephras.

304802.text: Oh, and for you in particular, $c. Our scouts learned of your involvement with what happened to the magister, Belathaan Brightwish. If we know, the High Order surely knows as well.

304803.text: The High Order are not likely to be understanding, accidental or not. There will be a reckoning. I can only hope that cool heads prevail between your faction and the High Order... at least until the crisis with the Al'Aketh is resolved.

305106.text: Sorry that we are late, Ayessa.

305107.text: It took a bit of work to convince Archmage Rhonin to help me open that transplanar portal...

305108.text: Ansirem! This isn't how I expected our first meeting to go, but I'm glad you made it!

305109.text1: Nor is this how I envisioned our first meeting, Muln.

305110.text: Well if this isn't an inspirational sight. The little elves seem to have friends in... low places.

305111.text: We have no quarrel with you, Lord of the East Wind. Leave us in peace.

305112.text: Very well, mortals. For now enjoy your respite. I simply cannot wait to tell the Windlord about all that has transpired here. You will be seeing me again... very soon.

305131.text1: Empty threats, Elaadrin. Regardless of what happens to me now, my great work is done. Consider yourself lucky to be here at the eye of the storm, to witness the fruits of our labor.

305132.text: Wait... what is this place? How could such a place exist in the Windlord's realm?

305133.text: I think it's time for us to be leaving this place. I will open a portal to Valanaar.

305134.text1: Muln Earthfury of the Earthen Ring--the Windshapers would be happy to accept you as our guest.

305135.text: Yes, and you, Archmage Runeweaver. The High Order is eager to learn more of the Kirin Tor.

305877.text1:
Lorthuna is performing some sort of ritual up there. She may be trying to bring down the wards!

The help we sent for has not yet arrived, but we'll just have to manage with what we have. When you are ready, let me know and we'll go confront her.

306575.text1: $n, ensure any allies with you are prepared to fight, and speak with me when you are ready to confront Lorthuna.

306593.text: <The gaze of the ranger standing before you is fixed on the enormous anchor pylon in the distance.>
306593.text1: <The gaze of the ranger standing before you is fixed on the enormous anchor pylon in the distance.>

307915.text: Watch yourself. The High Order will not tolerate hostility in our lodge.
307915.text1: Watch yourself. The High Order will not tolerate hostility in our lodge.

312221.text: <Riaani seems to be intently focused on his work on the wind construct.>
312221.text1: <Riaani seems to be intently focused on his work on the wind construct.>

314601.text: Wait, yes... this crystal! Valennia, is this...

314602.text1: ...a recall crystal! Used to record an important moment, no doubt.

314603.text: This is surely what the turncoat hoped to offer us in exchange for our protection.

314604.text1: The recall crystal is badly damaged, though. The recording is likely to be incomplete, so we must listen carefully.

314605.text: Activate it, Valennia. We need to learn as much as we can about what it contains.

314606.text1: ...do not delay. Muster our forces to march immediately. The pylons are key and...the wards...come down. This is...

314607.text1: ...quickly. With our forces.....will be exposed.....my ritual must not....

314608.text1: I alone am.....this task....the Windlord will.......our voices.....he will come.....we must not fail!

314609.text1: The crystal is too damaged to play any further, I am afraid.

314610.text: Wards... what is this about wards, Valennia?

314611.text1: The anchor pylons keep us suspended in this realm, but they also act as wards! The Shal'nan once spoke of this. They keep us shielded from...

314612.text: ...whatever else is out there in Skywall. Spirits save us... this is her plan. Bring down the wards and let her 'Windlord' in!

316076.text:
We paladins must earn our place amongst our Forsaken kin each day, lest we be judged as fanatics like the Scarlet Crusade. The light is not simply a tool of our foes, but a conduit for our righteous fury! It is in our devotion to the Dark Lady and the love of our home that we may channel the light to bring justice to our enemies.

The Banshee Queen keeps a close eye on us. Let her. She will see that our resolve shall never waver. We are Forsaken!

316310.text: It is vital that we learn more about what the cult is planning, and with the turncoat dead, the information may have died with him...

321055.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

Greetings, $c. Are you in need of arms?

I was trained by Antarion of Ban'aethal, using secrets handed down from the ancient master magesmiths of Kalimdor.

You'll find no finer weapons on Zephras Isle than mine.

324145.text1: All of the skyborne islands became destabilized and began to move apart a few years ago. If that wasn't bad enough, now large pieces of Zephras are beginning to fall away. It's hard to imagine your home falling into the sky, but that is my reality now.

324551.text: Ayessa Dawnsinger. The Supreme Magister of the High Order awaits your reply to his inquiry.
324551.text1: Ayessa Dawnsinger. The Supreme Magister of the High Order awaits your reply to his inquiry.

324552.text1: Inquiry? You mean his thinly veiled threat? You go back and tell Elaadrin that if he has something to say, he can come and speak to me himself.

324555.text1: No one? I thought not. You go tell Elaadrin that the only thing keeping me from marching my shamans over and tossing you petty charlatans off the side of this island is the current crisis.

324557.text1: It's 'Grand Skyseer' to you, mage. Now leave. Run along back to your master before I truly lose my patience.

325825.text: Mind yourself in the presence of the Warchief, $c. The Kor'kron will suffer no insolence or insult here.

325830.text: I am Vol'jin, of the Darkspear. Do you be friend, or enemy?

326965.text: Our kind are rare these days, but there are those who still dream in emerald amongst the Shen'dorei.

328198.text:
Welcome to my barbershop! We offer cuts, colorings, and more.

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, ink night elf tattoos, anything you might need.

Have a seat and we'll get to work.
